title: Orchard-Planting Problem
exact_target: What is the largest number of straight rows containing exactly three trees obtainable by planting n trees at distinct planar points?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1382 (GEOM-023). CC BY 4.0.
Ben Green and Terence Tao, \emph{On sets defining few ordinary lines} (2013), arXiv:1208.4714v3, Theorem 1.3 and Section 9 (the orchard problem).
